label: manifest-derivation
command: import json,collections,hashlib,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('tests/data/baseline_cohort_manifest.json'); b=p.read_bytes(); m=json.loads(b.decode('utf-8')); legs=m['legs']; c=collections.Counter(l['path'].split('/')[1] for l in legs); print('sha256(manifest)=',hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()); print('cohort_id=',m['cohort_id'],'frozen_on=',m['frozen_on'],'root=',m['root']); print('declared leg_count=',m['leg_count'],' actual len(legs)=',len(legs),' unique paths=',len({l['path'] for l in legs})); [print('  ',k,'=',c[k]) for k in sorted(c)]; print('  SUM =',sum(c.values()))
